name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Create an API key in incident.io under **Settings → API keys** with at least the **View data** permission.

name: catalogTypes
label: Catalog types to import (optional)
help: Import the entries of these catalog types, so you can filter incidents by them and open a dashboard for each one. Type each catalog type's name exactly as it appears in incident.io under **Catalog**, then press Enter. Leave empty to import no catalog entries.
